task_title: Causal T7lac expression and native lysate preparation

children.name: Runs the seeded construct once and reports the authoritative prepared-lysate result
children.requirement: Exactly one paired run_protein_expression request/output is complete; the output is internally consistent, accepted, and causally tied to the seeded construct; the final answer contains exactly the 11 required unique fields and matches the output.
children.grading_notes: Request-only calls, orphan outputs, partial/error outputs, retries, forged argument fields, duplicate report lines, and unsupported success states receive zero task-success credit.

children.name: Uses an allowlisted DE3 T7 expression host
children.requirement: Simulator output resolves the submitted host to an allowlisted DE3 host.
children.grading_notes: Exact allowlist canonicalization is used; substring-containing and negated host labels do not pass.

children.name: Uses IPTG within the supported pET range
Induces in the supported mid-log window
Uses a supported coupled induction schedule
children.requirement: Temperature and duration jointly resolve to one supported schedule profile.
children.grading_notes: Temperature and duration are not scored independently.

children.name: Diagnoses every returned expression failure reason
children.requirement: Diagnosis accounts for every ordered failure reason returned by the one complete simulator result; an accepted internally consistent lysate receives full no-failure credit.
children.grading_notes: Multiple failures are scored fractionally by resolved failure reason.

children.name: Uses exactly one experimental expression action
children.requirement: Exactly one run_protein_expression action is used.
children.grading_notes: Reference and safety lookups are excluded from the experimental-action budget.
